entities.name: Transylvanian Plain
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: The Transylvanian Plain is an ethnogeographical area in Transylvania, Romania, located between the Someșul Mare and the Someșul Mic rivers to the north and west and the Mureș River to the south and east. It is populated by both ethnic Romanians and ethnic Hungarians.
